Group Link: https://www.roblox.com/communities/508213614/TAKEOFF-INTERACTIVE

Created by @Acetul as a personal passion project and an exploration of the capabilities of the Roblox Engine.

This is an unofficial, fan-made project inspired by Counter-Strike 2. It is developed for entertainment and educational purposes only, with no monetization, no intention of generating profit, and no commercial purpose.

All rights to Counter-Strike 2, Counter-Strike, and any Valve-owned assets used in this project belong to their respective owners, including Valve Corporation. Their inclusion does not imply endorsement, sponsorship, or affiliation with Valve Corporation.

This project is independently developed by a fan and is not an official Valve product.

**PC CONTROLS**
- `K` — Push To Talk (Unmute First)
- `P` — Open pause menu
- `WASD` — Movement
- `M1` — Shoot
- `M2` — Secondary Use
- `E` — Use / Pick Up
- `G` — Drop Weapon
- `Space` — Jump
- `LCTRL` — Crouch
- `LShift` — Walk
- `R` — Reload
